objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow got a deliberate decision (docs-site and deploy path-filtered, tests handled in-workflow), and the required `unit-tests` check got exactly the one correct shape — a single workflow with no workflow-level paths that computes a `run` output and gates the real steps with `if:` — with no companion skip workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths track what its own steps consume (docs-site: docs/mkdocs/self; deploy: src/deps/deploy.sh/self; tests diff: src/test/deps/self), rather than a catch-all or sibling copy, though `test` vs a possible `tests` dir is an unverified guess.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule/dispatch (nightly-sweep) and issue-driven (triage) workflows were left untouched, the branch-protection ruleset was not modified, and only the three change-driven workflow files the audit called for were edited.
